profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Cadence Design Systems

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description: Oversaw broadcast operations and the physical space of the radio station. Communicated and collaborated with the President, Advisory Board, Technology Department, and members of the Board of Trustees to resolve equipment, staffing, and general broadcasting issues of the radio station to ensure smooth operation.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Led backend development of new delivery app in React Native with driver tracking
- Implemented backend in Node.js through AWS, Google Firebase, and Google Sheets
- Deployed continuous integration of delivery app for iOS and Android builds in Visual Studio App Center
- Implemented heat map in React showing frequency of driver position from delivery app data
Developed an Alexa Skill prototype companion to the Choco mobile app with a backend handling Amazon Echo notifications and confirmation emails with formatting through Handlebars.js

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
Programmed safety measures for a robotic arm to allow automation of quality testing of manufactured products.
Wrote low-level hardware communication library in C for interfacing between a Raspberry Pi and a robotic grasper to prevent collisions with environment.
Wrote a web interface in Python with Flask to give access to the robotic grasper’s data over the local network.

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.description: Planned and managed the construction of four raised garden beds at Franklin Township Middle School West for the students of the CIP program.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Sep 2015

organizations.name: Harvard Radio Broadcasting Co., Inc.
organizations.position: Director of Studio Engineering · Oct 2017 - Nov 2018
organizations.description: Oversaw the Studio Engineering department at Harvard Radio Broadcasting Co., Inc. Produced and delegated production of commercial announcements. Managed studio rentals from other broadcasting and media companies.
